admissible_pre_tfg_turns.text:
I have a notification that prompts the user to sign in again when the service disconnects. I want the notification to go away once they click the notification. However, that isn't working, can you help me debug it?

Here is the code that triggers the notification:

    private fun signedOutNotification() {
        val notificationBuilder = NotificationCompat.Builder(this, notificationChannel.id)
        val notification =
            notificationBuilder
                .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_firezone_logo)
                .setContentTitle(SIGN_IN_NOTIFICATION_TITLE)
                .setContentText(SIGN_IN_NOTIFICATION_TEXT)
                .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH)
                .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_STATUS)
                .setContentIntent(configIntent())
                .setAutoCancel(true)
                .build()

        startForeground(SIGN_IN_NOTIFICATION_ID, notification)
    }

identification.family_label: Kotlin BroadcastReceiver and PendingIntent for stopping a foreground service when its notification is tapped
identification.rationale: The sole candidate is generated in the earliest assistant response and forms a coherent Kotlin implementation: a BroadcastReceiver handles the notification tap, stops the foreground service, and configIntent() supplies the corresponding PendingIntent. The immediately preceding user turn requested help dismissing the foreground-service notification on tap.
